abstract: The association between mediastinal teratoma and acute megakaryoblastic leukemia (AMKL) in a 15-year-old boy is described. The clinical course is compared with 20 previously reported cases of AMKL in children. Chromosome studies at diagnosis of the leukemia showed multiple leukemic stem lines with numerical and structural abnormalities.
abstract_ja: 15歳男児における縦隔奇形腫と急性巨核芽球性白血病の関連を述べる。臨床経過を、小児急性巨核芽球性白血病の既報20例と比較する。白血病診断時の染色体検査で、数的・構造的異常を伴う複数の白血病幹細胞系統が明らかになった。
